description: Create a 10-minute USD-priced invoice for USDC on Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/Optimism/Polygon/Linea/Sei EVM/Arc; USDS on Ethereum/Base; ETH on Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/Optimism; BNB on BNB Smart Chain; POL on Polygon; SOL on Solana mainnet; or BTC on Bitcoin mainnet on-chain. EVM/optional Solana buyer address may be supplied as buyer_wallet; Bitcoin requires no buyer address. Agent-seller orders require separate exact 75% seller and 25% HOBO transfers, both verified before delivery.
name: create_crypto_invoice
